fragments.text: Hello, everybody. I am really happy to be here. I am Felipe Chivas Ortiz, PID, Associate Professor of the University of San Paulo and Representative of the Regional Committee for Latin America and the Caribbean of UNESCO Milalines. The title of my speech today is Artificial Intelligence, Policy and Ethics, three related issues in the post-human society. In this presentation, we will first define according to know authors what the mean by artificial intelligence, ethics, and public policies. Then we will talk about the multiple relatives' friendship between these three elements. Milal's speech today will be a provocation where I will address some of the challenges that involve these three factors closely related in today's work in my books from Smart Cities to Milal Cities,
